newsitem.title: ITALY: U.S. Navy frigate to visit Dubrovnik on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Navy frigate to visit Dubrovnik on Tuesday.

text.p: The U.S. Navy announced on Monday that one of its ships, the guided missile frigate USS Klakring, would visit the Croatian port of Dubrovnik on Tuesday.
A statement from the Italy-based U.S. Sixth Fleet said the Klakring, based in Norfolk, Virginia, would be the first U.S. ship to visit Croatia since the nation's independence.

"This visit represents another important step forward for regional stability and security and also shows the Sixth Fleet's continuing commitment to peaceful engagement in the region," the statement said.

It said the frigate would remain in Dubrovnik for three days and its crew would meet Croatian naval officers for discussions "on non-combat topics associated with the U.S. frigate Klakring, its crew and its mission as part of the U.S. Sixth Fleet".
The Klakring has 25 officers, 16 chief petty officers and 183 enlisted personnel, the Sixth Fleet said.
